science.title: Simple changes to fishing gear and handling can greatly improve survival of released coho salmon
science.description: Coho salmon released by recreational anglers are far more likely to survive when handled without a landing net, according to new research. In salmon fisheries where anglers may be required to release salmon that are undersized, wild or not the target species, post-release survival is critical to conservation efforts. The paper is published in the journal Fisheries Research.

ai.title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Minnesota over its first-in-the-nation law banning 'nudification' technology
ai.description: Elon Musk’s company xAI is suing Minnesota over the state’s first-in-the-nation law that bans “nudification” technology on websites and apps. The lawsuit was filed Monday in federal court and potentially provides a test for how far states can go in constitutionally regulating the use of artificial intelligence. xAI's chatbot and image generator Grok is available online. It says Minnesota’s law is overly broad and bans many constitutionally protected images and videos. The law is distinct from state and federal laws that typically penalize people who use AI tools to create sexually explicit deepfakes. xAI says its terms of service for using Grok prohibit using it for illegal, harmful, or abusive activities, including nudification.
